definition: LPA* or Lifelong Planning A* is an incremental heuristic search algorithm based on A*.
details: It was first described by Sven Koenig and Maxim Likhachev in 2001.
story: Think of a referee whose job is to be completely honest about who touched the ball last. Before trusting a machine, someone has to measure how good it really is — fairly and honestly. It is the exam that separates “it sounds good” from “it actually is good”. What gets measured is what actually gets better. And that, done honestly, is Lifelong Planning A*.
